ei.title: The Life and Achievements of Bessie Smith, the Empress of the Blues

fullPassage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie ①<u>was born</u>, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she ②<u>making</u> her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, ③<u>accompanied</u> by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still ④<u>remembered</u> today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① was born: 수동태 과거형 '태어났다' — 적절.
✅ ② making: 문장의 주어 she의 본동사가 필요하므로 과거형 made가 맞음. 분사 making은 부적절.
❌ ③ accompanied: 과거분사가 수동 의미로 'musicians에 의해 동행된' — 적절.
❌ ④ remembered: 'is remembered'(기억되다) 수동태 — 적절.
det.tip: 독립절에는 본동사 필수. 분사 Ving만으로는 불가. made가 맞음.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and ①<u>unnoticed</u> childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues ②<u>singer</u>. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians ③<u>who</u> also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of ④<u>the</u> Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① unnoticed: 과거분사가 형용사로 childhood를 수식 — 적절.
✅ ② singer: 앞에 'one of the first great blues'가 있으므로 복수형 singers가 필요. 'one of + 복수명사' 구문.
❌ ③ who: 선행사 musicians(사람)을 받는 주격 관계대명사 — 적절.
❌ ④ the: 'the Blues'(고유명사적 장르명) — 적절.
det.tip: one of + the/소유격 + 복수명사: 'one of the first great blues singers.'

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time ①<u>she</u> was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show ②<u>with</u> Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, ③<u>who</u> became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player ④<u>Louis Armstrong</u>. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① she: Bessie를 가리키는 대명사 — 적절.
❌ ② with: 'toured with Ma Rainey'(함께 순회하다) 전치사 — 적절.
✅ ③ who: 선행사가 Down Hearted Blues(노래 제목, 사물)이므로 which가 맞음. 사물에 who는 부적절.
❌ ④ Louis Armstrong: 고유명사 — 적절.
det.tip: 사물 선행사에는 which, 사람 선행사에는 who. Down Hearted Blues는 노래 → which.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a ①<u>wealthy</u> and unnoticed childhood. Bessie died in 1937 and is still ④<u>remembered</u> today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① wealthy: 원문은 poor(가난한). 부모를 모두 여의고 언니에게 양육된 배경에서 '부유한'은 문맥상 부적절.
❌ ② recordings: '녹음/음반'을 만들었다 — 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ success: '엄청난 성공' — 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ remembered: '기억되고 있다' — 원문 그대로.
det.tip: poor ↔ wealthy. 부모 사망 후 언니에게 키워진 배경 = 가난한 어린 시절.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still ①<u>remembered</u> today as the "②<u>Empress</u> of the Blues." Her music continues to ③<u>inspire</u> new generations, and she is widely considered the greatest blues ④<u>athlete</u> of all time.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① remembered: '기억되고 있다' — 적절.
❌ ② Empress: '여제' — 원문 별칭 그대로.
❌ ③ inspire: '영감을 주다' — 적절.
✅ ④ athlete: Bessie Smith는 운동선수가 아니라 블루스 가수. singer가 맞음.
det.tip: singer ↔ athlete. 글 전체가 음악(블루스) 분야 인물의 일대기.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues." Bessie's life shows that talent can __________ even in the most difficult circumstances.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가장 어려운 환경에서도 재능은 빛날 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ shine: 가난한 어린 시절, 교육 부재에도 불구하고 Bessie는 블루스의 여제가 되었으므로 '빛나다'가 적절.
❌ ① disappear: '사라지다'는 본문의 성공 스토리와 반대.
❌ ② be hidden: '숨겨지다'는 성공적 결과와 모순.
❌ ④ be purchased: '구매되다'는 재능과 어울리지 않음.
det.tip: 어려운 환경 → 성공 = 역경 극복 서사. 'shine'(빛나다)이 핵심.

ch: shine even in the most difficult circumstances

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was __________ by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ reared: 부모가 모두 사망한 후 '가장 나이 많은 언니 Viola에 의해 양육되었다'는 문맥.
❌ ① abandoned: '버려졌다'는 Viola가 키운 사실과 반대.
❌ ② taught: '가르침을 받았다'는 교육을 받지 못했다는 내용과 모순.
❌ ③ ignored: '무시되었다'는 양육 관계와 반대.
det.tip: rear = raise = 양육하다. 수동태로 'was reared by ~'(~에 의해 키워지다).

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: Bessie의 아버지는 그녀가 태어난 직후에 사망했다 — 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① Bessie의 아버지는 그녀가 태어난 직후에 세상을 떠났다: 본문 'Her father died shortly after Bessie was born' 일치.
❌ ② Bessie는 어머니에 의해 양육되었다: 어머니는 8~9세 때 사망. 언니 Viola가 양육.
❌ ③ Bessie는 대학에서 음악 교육을 받았다: 교육을 받지 못했다고 명시.
❌ ④ Down Hearted Blues는 상업적으로 실패했다: 200만 장 이상 판매된 성공작.
det.tip: shortly after = ~직후에. 아버지 사망 시점 = 출생 직후.

ch: Bessie의 아버지는 그녀가 태어난 직후에 세상을 떠났다.

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 그녀는 1894년 테네시주에서 태어났다: 본문 일치.
❌ ② 그녀의 어머니는 그녀가 8~9세일 때 세상을 떠났다: 본문 일치.
✅ ③ 그녀는 약 60곡을 녹음했다: 본문은 approximately 160 songs. 60곡이 아닌 160곡.
❌ ④ 그녀는 오늘날에도 '블루스의 여제'로 기억되고 있다: 본문 일치.
det.tip: 숫자 함정: approximately 160 songs ≠ 약 60곡.

ch: 그녀의 어머니는 그녀가 8~9세일 때 세상을 떠났다.

She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 위 글에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것은?

det.korean: 그녀와 함께 작업한 음악가 중에는 Louis Armstrong이 있었다 — 일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① Ma Rainey는 Bessie의 언니였다: Ma Rainey는 초기 블루스 가수이지 언니가 아님.
❌ ② Bessie는 정규 교육을 충분히 받았다: 'unable to gain an education'(교육을 받지 못함).
❌ ③ Bessie의 첫 녹음은 1913년에 이루어졌다: 1913년은 순회공연, 첫 녹음은 1923년.
✅ ④ 그녀의 녹음에는 유명 트럼펫 연주자가 동행했다: 'including trumpet player Louis Armstrong' 일치.

ch: 그녀의 녹음에는 유명 트럼펫 연주자가 동행했다.

Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 역경을 딛고 블루스 역사에 이름을 남긴 가수의 일대기.
det.analysis:
✅ ② the life and legacy of a legendary blues singer who overcame hardship: 가난한 어린 시절을 극복하고 블루스의 여제가 된 Bessie Smith의 삶과 유산.
❌ ① the economic impact of blues music on Tennessee: 테네시 경제 영향은 본문 주제 아님.
❌ ③ how formal education shapes a musician's career: Bessie는 교육을 받지 못했으므로 반대.
❌ ④ the history of recording technology in the 1920s: 1920년대 녹음 기술 역사는 본문과 무관.
det.tip: 글 전체 주제 = Bessie Smith의 일대기 + 역경 극복 + 블루스 레전드.

ch: the economic impact of blues music on Tennessee
the life and legacy of a legendary blues singer who overcame hardship
how formal education shapes a musician's career
the development of sound recording in early 20th-century America

questions.stem: 위 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① Bessie Smith: From Hardship to the Empress of the Blues: 가난한 배경에서 블루스의 여제까지 오른 일대기를 요약.
❌ ② The Decline of Blues Music in America: 블루스 쇠퇴는 본문과 반대.
❌ ③ How Ma Rainey Created Modern Blues: Ma Rainey는 조연, 주인공은 Bessie.
❌ ④ Louis Armstrong and His Musical Partners: Louis Armstrong은 언급되지만 주인공이 아님.
det.tip: 제목 = 핵심 인물 + 핵심 내용. 'From Hardship to Empress'가 글 전체 요약.

ch: Bessie Smith: From Hardship to the Empress of the Blues

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. <u>Bessie's big break came in 1923</u>, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "Bessie's big break came in 1923"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 1923년에 Bessie에게 성공의 결정적 기회가 찾아왔다는 것.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 첫 녹음 성공으로 그녀의 음악 경력이 크게 도약한 전환점이 되었다: 'big break'는 성공의 결정적 기회를 뜻하며, 첫 녹음이 200만 장 이상 팔린 대성공으로 이어짐.
❌ ① 그녀가 1923년에 큰 부상을 당했다: 'break'가 '골절'이 아님.
❌ ② 그녀가 Ma Rainey와의 관계를 끊었다: 관계 단절 의미가 아님.
❌ ③ 그녀가 1923년에 가난에서 벗어나 학교에 다녔다: 학교와 무관.
det.tip: big break = (성공의) 결정적 기회/전환점. 'break'는 여기서 '기회'의 의미.

ch: 첫 녹음 성공으로 그녀의 음악 경력이 크게 도약한 전환점이 되었다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>which</u>가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② Down Hearted Blues라는 클래식 블루스 곡: 'including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success'에서 which의 선행사는 바로 앞의 Down Hearted Blues.
❌ ① Bessie Smith 본인: 사람이면 who.

❌ ④ Ma Rainey의 쇼: 쇼는 1913년, 시점 불일치.
det.tip: which의 선행사 = 바로 앞 명사구. 'Down Hearted Blues, which ~' 구조.

ch: Down Hearted Blues라는 클래식 블루스 곡

questions.passage: Bessie Smith was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee in 1894. She had a poor and unnoticed childhood. Her father died shortly after Bessie was born, and her mother died by the time she was eight or nine. Bessie was reared by <u>her</u> oldest sister Viola. As a consequence, Bessie was unable to gain an education. Around 1913 she toured in a show with Ma Rainey, one of the first great blues singers. Bessie's big break came in 1923, when she made her first recordings, including the classic Down Hearted Blues, which became an enormous success, selling more than two million copies. She recorded approximately 160 songs, accompanied by musicians who also made music history, including trumpet player Louis Armstrong. Bessie died in 1937 and is still remembered today as the "Empress of the Blues."
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>her</u>가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ Bessie Smith: 'Bessie was reared by her oldest sister Viola'에서 her은 Bessie의 소유격. Bessie의 가장 나이 많은 언니 Viola.
❌ ① Viola: Viola는 언니이지 her의 주인이 아님.
❌ ② Bessie의 어머니: 어머니는 이미 사망.
❌ ④ Ma Rainey: 이후 문장에 등장하는 인물.
det.tip: 대명사 her = 바로 앞 문장의 주어 Bessie를 지칭.
